descriptions.zh: 我们探测到了来自这颗星球的间歇性能量峰值。这些读数表明了一些强大的、远超我们所观察到的未开智物种所具有能力的某种东西。
descriptions.en: We have detected intermittent energy spikes coming from the planet. These readings indicate something powerful, and far beyond the capabilities of the pre-sapient inhabitants we've observed.
